'''Domdees''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] who worked in the [[Toydor Merchant District]]. He was once hired by the Toydarian [[Monarchy/Legends|king]] to cook his famous [[gabaki goulash]].<ref name="LoNH" />
